cohort: A total of 43 infants diagnosed with either Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) or Food Protein-Induced Allergic Protocolitis (FPIAP) were enrolled.
finding: Infants with NEC exhibited significantly different gut microbiota composition (e.g., higher Actinobacteria, lower Bacteroidetes) and SCFA concentrations (e.g., lower acetic, propionic, butyric acids, higher hexanoic acid) compared to infants with FPIAP.
